items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-21
items.q: They range. Can you tell? I could not tell. I wasn't there.

ctx.x: Columbia. The Columbia recording. Recording 77371. Good. Now we'll play this record. The father of the blues was given so much space on the paper by which I have

in my clippings, all of his stuff. At one time, he said he had the first original Dixon jazz band, this Negro, until I had him correct it and put back in his place. Into my files, you'll find that paper. When you look through him, you'll see the scholar look through that material and you'll come up where this nigga was even trying to take the Dixon Jazz band. It's kind of tame for a colored man's band. Well, he's dollars playing by Yara. They range.
Can you tell? I could not tell. I wasn't there. And I wouldn't say something
